hero.title: CatCheck Shop
hero.subtitle: Color-indicator litter and litter tray accessories
hero.body: Indicator granules change color with urine, helping you track your cat's pH trend at home. CatCheck does not diagnose illness and does not replace a vet.

phScale.title: pH reference range
phScale.body: The thresholds and labels below are configured by the CatCheck system and are exactly the labels the app uses when reading indicator granule color.
phScale.error: Couldn't load the pH reference range.

product.empty: The shop has no products yet.

careNote.title: CatCheck tracks pH trends, it does not diagnose illness
careNote.body: Indicator granule color is only an at-home observation. If you notice anything unusual about your cat, ask a vet.

buying.title: Buying on CatCheck
buying.subtitle: What the shop system can do today, stated as it is.

shipping.title: Shipping fees calculated by the system
shipping.body: The cart and orders show the exact amount the system returns based on order value, not an estimate in the interface.

payment.title: Pay on delivery or via PayOS
payment.body: Pay cash on delivery (COD) or scan a VietQR code via PayOS with your banking or e-wallet app.

tracking.title: Order status tracking
tracking.body: After you order, the order page shows the latest processing status from the system.

PAYOS.note: Scan the VietQR code with your banking or e-wallet app. Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically after 5 minutes.
